about: Strayed gear in the supply crate. Meshes and textures are read from the player's own Strayed install when Gorilla Tag starts; nothing from Strayed ships with the mod.

columns.id: stable id used by the other sheets
columns.strayedMesh: Mesh name inside Strayed_Data, or name#pathId when Strayed reuses the name (list with src/StrayedIndexTool)
columns.strayedTexture: Texture2D name (or name#pathId when reused) that the item prefab's material uses
columns.strayedDamage: damage in Strayed (strayed.wiki.gg/wiki/Tools player damage chart); 0 = not a weapon in the chart; informational, nobody is hurt in Gorilla Tag
columns.lengthM: real length in metres; MeshFit scales the Strayed mesh to it (Strayed authors items at mixed scales)
columns.lightRange: torch light range in metres, 0 when not a light
columns.verified: true once mesh + texture were traced to the item's prefab in a real Strayed install
